User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system, whether a member, leader, supervisor, or pastor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

hierarchy.description: Defines the user's position within the church hierarchy.

celulaId.description: The ID of the cell the user belongs to or leads.

supervisorId.description: The ID of the user's supervisor.

redeId.description: The ID of the network the user belongs to.

integrationStatus.description: The user's stage in the integration pipeline, differentiating between church and cell visitors.

gamification.description: Stores gamification data for the user, primarily for leaders.

lmsProgress.description: Tracks user's progress in different Learning Management System (LMS) tracks.

kidsData.description: Specific data for children, used for the Kids Cell module.

responsibleIds.description: Array of user IDs of parents or guardians.

restrictedPickup.description: Notes on who is restricted from picking up the child.

lastContactLog.description: Timestamp of the last contact with the user.

absenceCount.description: The number of times the user has been absent.

Cell.title: Cell
Cell.description: Represents a cell group (GC) within the church.

nome.description: The name of the cell group.

liderId.description: User ID of the Cell Leader (Líder de GC).

supervisorId.description: User ID of the Area Leader overseeing the cell.

areaId.description: The ID of the Area this cell belongs to.

redeId.description: The ID of the Rede this cell belongs to.

membros.description: Array of user IDs who are members of this cell.

address.description: The meeting address for the cell, including geocoordinates.

meetingDay.description: The day of the week the cell meets.

healthStats.description: Stores health score and related stats for the cell.

linkedKidsCellId.description: ID of the linked kids cell, if any.

Area.title: Area
Area.description: Represents a geographical or logical area containing multiple cell groups.

liderId.description: User ID of the Area Leader.

redeId.description: The ID of the Rede this area belongs to.

Rede.title: Rede
Rede.description: Represents a network, a high-level grouping of multiple areas.

liderId.description: User ID of the Network Leader.

pastorId.description: User ID of the overseeing Pastor.

AttendanceReport.title: AttendanceReport
AttendanceReport.description: Represents an attendance report for a cell meeting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AttendanceReport entity.

cellId.description: Reference to Cell. (Relationship: Cell 1:N AttendanceReport) The ID of the cell the report belongs to.

date.description: The date of the cell meeting.

presentMembers.description: References to Users. (Relationship: User N:N AttendanceReport) An array of user IDs representing the users present at the meeting.

visitantes.description: String with names and contact info of visitors.

conversoes.description: The number of conversions reported at the meeting.

LeaderTask.title: LeaderTask
LeaderTask.description: Represents a task assigned to a cell leader.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LeaderTask entity.

liderId.description: Reference to User (Cell Leader). (Relationship: User 1:N LeaderTask) The ID of the cell leader assigned the task.

targetUserId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N LeaderTask) The ID of the user the task is related to.

message.description: The message associated with the task.

dueDate.description: The due date for the task.

DiscipleshipPlan.title: DiscipleshipPlan
DiscipleshipPlan.description: Represents a discipleship plan between a leader (mentor) and a user (disciple).

id.description: Unique identifier for the DiscipleshipPlan entity.

liderId.description: Reference to User (Mentor/Leader). (Relationship: User 1:N DiscipleshipPlan) The ID of the leader/mentor.

auxiliarId.description: Reference to User (Disciple). (Relationship: User 1:N DiscipleshipPlan) The ID of the user being discipled.

status.description: The status of the discipleship plan (e.g., 'identificado', 'demonstrando', 'delegando').

checklist.description: A checklist of development steps in the discipleship plan.

CultoRegistro.title: CultoRegistro
CultoRegistro.description: Represents a record of attendance and other details for a church service (culto).

id.description: Unique identifier for the CultoRegistro entity.

data.description: The date of the church service.

horario.description: The time of the church service.

adultos.description: The number of adults attending the service.

criancas.description: The number of children attending the service.

clima.description: The weather conditions during the service.

feriadoProximo.description: Indicates whether there was a holiday near the service date.

jogoFutebol.description: Indicates whether there was a soccer game during the service time.

serieMensagem.description: The message series being preached during the service.

apresentacaoBebe.description: Indicates whether there was a baby presentation during the service.

criadoEm.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

MemberNote.title: Member Note
MemberNote.description: Represents a note or log entry for a user, created by a leader.

authorId.description: The ID of the leader who created the note.

memberId.description: The ID of the user the note is about.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the note was created.

definition.description: Represents cell groups (GCs). Contains leadership and hierarchy info.
Stores attendance reports for cell meetings.
Tracks tasks assigned to cell leaders.
Manages discipleship plans between leaders and users.
Stores records of attendance for church services, owned by each user.
Stores notes about users made by leaders.
